question: At one fixed complete first public flux/charge record, can the validated signed-character quotient enumerate exact first-record masses for every same-flux private error under the unchanged physical prior within the inherited work cap, and what fraction of that record's probability is covered by the 55 existing complete-second-law errors?
fork_classification: J9E validated the algebraic prerequisite but not coverage. The full selected-flux coset is exactly 8,192 private errors; a mass-only census is the smallest dependent test. Run direct affine enumeration when cheaper and quadratic elimination otherwise, both under one aggregate cap; this is an experiment-design choice, not a human ranking. A cap hit is a prospective censored outcome and cannot be repaired by silently increasing resources.

hypotheses.complete: All 8,192 exact first masses fit the 65,536 signed-phase/200,000 first-site/60-CPU-second caps, replay all 55 known masses and the J9E stress, and yield an exact selected-record denominator and known-law coverage fraction.
hypotheses.censored: A cap or source/integrity gate stops before all 8,192; report only prefix cost and no full-record posterior denominator or known-law coverage.
hypotheses.rejected: Any known mass, stress control, first-flux coset count, prior mass or first-variable histogram disagrees; withhold the census and diagnose implementation/provenance before downstream work.

model_boundary: R6AF ideal periodic L=2 D4 projector/fusion instrument, 36 IID red-X edges at exact p_X=1/10 and p_Z=0, ground-state-relative logical convention. The selected public first record is J8I's complete 24-bit flux with only sites 0 and 3 occupied and all 24 charge bits zero; vacuum membership is deterministically implied by that public flux/charge under the established interface, not independently sampled here. Private errors are analysis-only. No second action is chosen or evaluated in this mass-only stage.

matrix.errors: Enumerate every 13-dimensional GF(2) boundary-kernel coset mask generated from J8I's first base error, in deterministic order 0..8191; each has the same first public flux. Evaluate the exact selected all-zero first-charge mass for each error and its fixed IID prior weight.
matrix.method: Use J9E's validated affine signature and quadratic Gauss-sum quotient, with direct affine enumeration when fewer phase evaluations. Check a deterministic held-out phase subset every 64th coset error. Aggregate exact prior-weighted mass only if all 8,192 finish.
matrix.controls: Replay all 55 J8I known first masses, J9E's fixed-prefix stress mass, J8J's full first-variable-site histogram and selected-flux physical prior mass; require nonnegative normalized first masses and full source/runner hash stability.
matrix.independent_unit: One exact private-error term in a deterministic full finite coset; no stochastic sampling or confidence interval.
matrix.integrity: The decoder-visible record contains only public flux/charge/vacuum, never private error identity. Preserve the full denominator, exact rational prior, first-record timing and inherited L=2 geometry. A truncated prefix is censored and must not be normalized as the selected-record posterior.

acceptance: Enumerate all 8,192 same-flux private errors or record a cap-censored prefix without posterior claims
Replay all 55 known masses, fixed stress mass, J8J site histogram and exact prior mass before any complete selected-record denominator is accepted
If complete, report exact selected first-public-record probability and the 55 known-law errors' share at that record only; do not compute a second law or full-IID risk
stop_rule: Stop after exactly 8,192 masks or first 65,536 signed-phase/200,000 first-site/60-CPU-second/source/integrity failure. No extension, resampling, complete second law, mixture over other first records, history, schedule arm, bootstrap or enlarged budget in this tick.
